messages:
noah: quick idea — before the pricing launch, can we run a tiny CTA & FAQ cadence experiment tied to the calculator? need to test: 1) CTA copy (Try vs Estimate vs See pricing) 2) inline FAQ snippet length 3) routing for webinar leads vs demo requests
izzy: love it. suggest we gate the higher-intent CTA (Request demo) behind the webinar sign-up for the first 48h to drive attendance, then swap to direct demo after day 2. simple feature flag.
ravi: routing note — we can tag leads with utm_campaign=pricing_launch_A or _B and webhook to sales-ops. sample rule: if intent=demo and utm_campaign contains "pricing_launch_B" -> sales queue A; else -> nurture list.
claire: copy variants I sketched in drafts doc: https://docs.google.com/s/PRICING-CTA-DRAFTS (feel free to edit). Short versions: "Estimate your cost" / "See a tailored estimate" / "Compare tiers instantly"
noah: nice — can we also try a super-compact FAQ microcopy under the calculator: 1 sentence + expand link vs full 3-bullet FAQ? want to measure drop-off and support tickets.
izzy: metric plan: funnel events = click CTA, sign-up, webinar attend, demo request, SQL flagged. Also track calculator interactions (tokens, steps). tag experiment id in events.
ravi: example routing config we can use (pseudo):
```
if (lead.intent == 'demo' && lead.utm.includes('A')) {
  route('sd-sdr-queue')
} else if (lead.intent == 'demo') {
  route('marketing-nurture')
} else {
  route('content-nurture')
}
```
claire: for benchmark narrative: we should lead the launch post with a short benchmark: "new pricing estimator reduces time-to-first-estimate by 80% vs manual" — but avoid numbers we can't back. instead: "instantly get a tailored estimate" then link to deep bench doc.
noah: good caution. we can have an appendix with full benchmark details for press and docs, but public copy stays qualitative.
izzy: webinar hooks — run a 20min demo + 10min live Q. CTA on pricing page will have: Variant A -> "Request demo" (immediate demo flow), Variant B -> "Estimate your monthly spend" (calculator modal). we route Variant A leads to webinar for first 48h like mentioned.
ravi: can we add a quick fallback: if sales queue is > X pending leads, auto-switch routing to nurture and notify ops? avoids SLO misses.
claire: tracking checklist for launch day: 1) experiment flags live 2) GA+mixpanel events mapped 3) webhook rules deployed 4) GTM tags for webinar & calculator 5) copy variant A/B uploaded to CMS
noah: who can own the experiment dashboard? prefer someone from growth to own daily checks. @izzy can you take lead?
izzy: I can. I'll set up a dashboard in Looker for the key funnel steps and add a short ref page in the doc for what numbers to watch. will also add the cohort for webinar vs direct demo.
noah: perfect. timeline: flag & copy live tomorrow 09:00 PT, monitor for 72h, decision to flip or broaden on day 4. please post quick summaries in #marketing-ops each morning. :rocket:
sam-marketing-bot: Deploy started: feature-flag pricing_cta_experiment -> staging (logs: https://ci.example/dev/1123)
izzy: headed into staging QA now. tagging @ravi for routing review later today.
ravi: will review webhook rules after lunch and share the small playbook for ops fallback thresholds.
claire: I'll finalize the FAQ microcopy and create the CMS snippets — sending final by 17:00 PT.
noah: thanks team. quick win if we get clearer CTAs and fewer support asks. keep it tight and lightweight.
izzy: noted. will post the final tracking matrix and the Looker link in this thread when ready.
